cron.description: Cron expression (5 fields) or shortcut (@daily, @hourly, etc.) for when to run the monitor. Example: '0 9 * * 1-5' for weekdays at 9am UTC.

monitor_name.description: Optional name for this monitoring job (e.g. 'morning-tech-check').

next_runs.description: Number of upcoming schedule run times to include (default 5, max 20).

tickers.description: Up to 5 US stock ticker symbols to monitor (e.g. ['AAPL','NVDA','MSFT']).

Replaces separate cron-parser + stock-price-multi calls.
